description:
Problem: AGENTS.md:26 and docs/agent/merge-authority.md let an agent post a stand-in when the owner names the PR; docs/agent/emergency-merge.md:21-28 forbids it 'whoever asks' (a clause #3337 added without discussion). merge-authority.md requires PR, head and a prior Owner instruction comment; AGENTS.md names only the PR. emergency-merge.md:63-77 says policy is no relaxation, then :79-95 prescribes one. docs/internal/repo-admin-settings.md:139-140 forbids touching the oracle-gate binding even when oracle-gate itself is the broken context, leaving no procedure for that case. _project/decisions/develop-tooling-context-removal-2026-10-24.md says 'Performed by the owner', but an agent performed it after owner approval. Relaxation windows on 2026-10-04 (#2612, #2621, #2635, and #2625 merged with oracle-review failing), 2026-10-13/14 (#2954) and 2026-10-14 (#2953, bypass actor) have no record. tests/fixtures/ruleset-develop-squash-only.json still lists oracle-review as required. The tracker's 2026-10-25 note keeping an agent-run ordinary bypass contradicts the merged docs.

Outcome (owner Q7, Q8): stand-ins: owner-named stand-ins allowed, AGENTS.md unchanged; emergency-merge.md and merge-authority.md require the same evidence (PR, head SHA, Owner instruction comment). Relaxation: owner-only everywhere (ratified, superseding the 2026-10-25 note), plus a procedure for a broken oracle-gate: the owner may remove oracle-gate for exactly one merge, then restore it and verify with scripts/ruleset_drift_check.py --compare-capture, which must confirm oracle-gate is bound to integration 5201041 again. The 2026-10-24 record is corrected; a new decision record documents the three unrecorded windows from ruleset history; the fixture is refreshed from the live ruleset.

Decision gates:
1. AGENTS.md must not change (Q7). If a fix appears to need it, stop and ask with the proposed wording and its byte count (the instruction budget has about 27 bytes of headroom).
2. Re-read the current text of every quoted doc before editing; reconcile against the decisions, not stale quotes.
3. Window facts come only from the ruleset history API and PR and run records; label inferences.

Item guardrails: docs, decision records and the fixture only; no ruleset or settings change; no change to the checker's stand-in acceptance (owner adjudication is a separate item).

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. Never use git stash (refs/stash is shared across worktrees). Commit as Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>, staging explicit paths only; no git add -A, no --no-verify, no SKIP, no agent trailers. Durable text (commits, PR bodies, docs, code) carries no tracker ids, session labels or plan references. Maintained code has no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check). Before publishing run make docs-reference-inventory-check, make doc-contracts-guard and make pr-preflight, and self-review with the code review action, fixing every Critical and Required finding. Publish only with make pr-open: never gh pr create, a raw push-and-open, or a PR-body override line; if make pr-open refuses, stop and report the exact refusal instead of routing around it. Until oracle-omp-pin-single-source-20261026 merges, make pr-open may run only with PATH prefixed by the darwin-arm64 omp 18.12.1 build whose SHA-256 that item records, verified with shasum immediately before use; never any other side-loaded omp. Close out only with oracle SHIP on the exact head, every oracle thread answered (reply naming the fixing SHA, then resolve) and make pr-arm; never raw gh pr merge, a stand-in, an adjudication, or a ruleset or settings change. Never print tokens, keys, or the gateway URL or hostname; never spend model quota outside the review harness. Owner decisions are recorded in context and in the decisions file; a step that would contradict one stops and asks the owner.
